addons.name: Lirik Segerak
addons.desc: Lirik bergerak ikut lagu (dari LRCLIB). Butang Lirik di skrin pemain.
addons.desc_en: Lyrics that follow the song (from LRCLIB). Lyrics button on the player.

addons.name: Radio Malaysia & Dunia
addons.desc: Ratusan stesen radio internet. Muncul di skrin Utama.
addons.desc_en: Hundreds of internet radio stations. Appears on Home.

addons.name: Pek Tema
addons.desc: Buka tema Neon dan Sakura di Tetapan.
addons.desc_en: Unlocks the Neon and Sakura themes in Settings.

addons.name: Pembetul Bunyi Earphone (AutoEq)
addons.desc: Pilih model earphone/headphone anda — bunyi diseimbangkan ikut ukuran makmal (45 model). Kesan Bunyi → Addon kualiti.
addons.desc_en: Pick your earphone/headphone model — sound is corrected using lab measurements (45 models). Sound effects → Quality add-ons.

addons.name: Kelantangan Seimbang
addons.desc: Semua lagu pada kekuatan yang sama — tiada lagu tiba-tiba terlalu kuat atau perlahan.
addons.desc_en: Keeps every song at a similar loudness — no sudden loud or quiet tracks.

addons.name: Kualiti Auto Pintar
addons.desc: Ukur kelajuan internet dan pilih kualiti tertinggi yang tidak tersekat-sekat.
addons.desc_en: Checks your connection speed and picks the highest quality that won't stutter.

addons.name: Crossfade & Tanpa Jeda
addons.desc: Lagu pudar keluar dan masuk dengan lancar (2–10 saat). Album live dimainkan tanpa jeda.
addons.desc_en: Songs fade out and in smoothly (2–10 s). Live albums play without gaps.

addons.name: Pek Pratetap EQ
addons.desc: 8 pratetap baharu: Dangdut, Rock Kapak, Nasyid, Vokal Jelas, Bass Kereta, Akustik, Elektronik, Klasik.
addons.desc_en: 8 new presets: Dangdut, Rock Kapak, Nasyid, Clear Vocals, Car Bass, Acoustic, Electronic, Classical.
